```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

results_dir  <- params$results_dir
sample_list  <- params$sample_list
steps_run    <- str_trim(str_split(params$steps, ",")[[1]])

file_exists_msg <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    cat(paste0("> **File not found:** `", path, "` — this step may not have been run.\n\n"))
    return(FALSE)
  }
  TRUE
}
```

# Overview

The **MAGs Generation** pipeline is a Snakemake-based metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) workflow.
Starting from raw paired-end reads, it performs quality trimming, metagenome assembly, multi-tool
binning, bin refinement, dereplication, taxonomy assignment and a range of downstream analyses.

Results directory: **`r results_dir`**

The sections below cover a run summary (samples, assemblies, MAGs), pipeline steps executed,
MAG quality, taxonomy, coverage, eukaryotic MAGs, synteny (SynTracker), metagenome completeness
(SingleM), optimal growth temperature (MGThermometer), functional annotation (EggNOG), and a
table of all tools and references.

---

# 1. Run Summary

```{r run-summary}
# ── samples ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_samples <- NA_integer_
if (file.exists(sample_list)) {
  samples <- readLines(sample_list)
  samples <- samples[nzchar(trimws(samples))]
  n_samples <- length(samples)
}

# ── assemblies ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
assembly_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Assembly")
n_assemblies <- NA_integer_
if (dir.exists(assembly_dir)) {
  asm_files    <- list.files(assembly_dir, pattern = "_filter\\.fasta$", full.names = FALSE)
  n_assemblies <- length(asm_files)
}

# ── trimmed read pairs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
trim_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "TrimFinal")
n_read_pairs <- NA_integer_
if (dir.exists(trim_dir)) {
  trim_files   <- list.files(trim_dir, pattern = "_1\\.fq\\.gz$", full.names = FALSE)
  n_read_pairs <- length(trim_files)
}

# ── final dereplicated MAGs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
final_bins_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Bins", "finalBins")
n_mags <- NA_integer_
if (dir.exists(final_bins_dir)) {
  fa_files <- list.files(final_bins_dir, pattern = "\\.fa$", full.names = FALSE)
  n_mags   <- length(fa_files)
}

# ── eukaryotic MAGs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
euk_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Bins", "Eukaryotic_mags_dereplicated")
n_euk   <- NA_integer_
if (dir.exists(euk_dir)) {
  n_euk <- length(list.files(euk_dir, pattern = "\\.fa$"))
}

# ── quality breakdown (CheckM2) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
n_hq <- NA_integer_; n_mq <- NA_integer_; n_lq <- NA_integer_
checkm2_path <- file.path(results_dir, "Bins", "checkm2", "quality_report.tsv")
if (file.exists(checkm2_path)) {
  chk <- read_tsv(checkm2_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  n_hq <- sum(chk$Completeness >= 90 & chk$Contamination < 5,  na.rm = TRUE)
  n_mq <- sum(chk$Completeness >= 50 & chk$Contamination < 10 &
              !(chk$Completeness >= 90 & chk$Contamination < 5), na.rm = TRUE)
  n_lq <- nrow(chk) - n_hq - n_mq
}

summary_tbl <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples",
    "Trimmed read pairs",
    "Filtered assemblies",
    "Final dereplicated MAGs",
    "  — High Quality (≥90% comp., <5% cont.)",
    "  — Medium Quality (≥50% comp., <10% cont.)",
    "  — Low Quality",
    "Eukaryotic MAGs"
  ),
  Count = c(
    n_samples, n_read_pairs, n_assemblies,
    n_mags, n_hq, n_mq, n_lq,
    n_euk
  )
)

knitr::kable(summary_tbl, caption = "Run summary")
```

# 2. Pipeline Steps

```{r pipeline-steps, results='asis'}
step_info <- tribble(
  ~Step,                 ~Description,
  "install_software",    "Download and set up all required software databases (CheckM2, GTDBTk, SingleM, BUSCO, SynTracker).",
  "trim_reads",          "Adapter and quality trimming with **Trim Galore**, human-read removal with **strobealign**, and PCR-duplicate removal with **fastp**.",
  "assembly_all",        "De novo metagenome assembly per sample with **MEGAHIT** (min contig length 1 000 bp), followed by length filtering (≥1 500 bp) with **seqkit**.",
  "contigs_taxonomy",    "Contig-level taxonomic classification used to guide the TaxVAMB binner.",
  "check_assembly",      "Quality-check filtered assemblies and index them with **strobealign** for downstream read mapping.",
  "mags_generation",     "Cross-sample read mapping with **strobealign**; parallel binning with **Metabat2**, **Rosella**, **TaxVAMB**, **CONCOCT**, **COMEBin** and **SemiBin2**.",
  "binning_refinement",  "Per-sample bin consolidation with **DAS_Tool**, quality estimation with **CheckM2**.",
  "eukaryotes_filter",   "Size-filter large bins (>2.5 Mb), classify contigs as prokaryote/eukaryote with **DeepMicroClass** (>80% eukaryotic contigs retained), assess completeness with **BUSCO**.",
  "checkm",              "Quality assessment of per-sample DAS_Tool bins with **CheckM2**.",
  "refine_all",          "Bin refinement using **Rosella refine**, rename bins, then re-run **CheckM2** on the refined set.",
  "dereplicate",         "Filter bins (≥70% completeness, ≤10% contamination) and dereplicate across all samples with **Galah**.",
  "syntracker",          "Synteny-based strain tracking across samples with **SynTracker**.",
  "coverage",            "Map all reads to the final dereplicated MAGs with **CoverM** (trimmed mean).",
  "annotations",         "Gene prediction on all final MAGs with **pyrodigal**.",
  "quality",             "Final taxonomy assignment with **GTDBTk** and quality assessment with **CheckM2**.",
  "mgthermometer",       "Predict optimal growth temperature (OGT) from the relative abundance of IVYWREL amino acids (**MGThermometer**).",
  "eggnog",              "Functional annotation of predicted proteins with **EggNOG-mapper** (COG categories, KEGG pathways, GO terms).",
  "singlem_all",         "Read-based community profiling with **SingleM**; estimate the fraction of microbial diversity captured in the MAGs."
)

active <- step_info |> filter(Step %in% steps_run)

if (nrow(active) == 0) {
  cat("> No step information available — `steps` parameter may not have been set.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("The following pipeline steps were executed:\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(active))) {
    cat(paste0("**`", active$Step[i], "`** — ", active$Description[i], "\n\n"))
  }
}
```

# 4. MAG Quality (CheckM2)

```{r checkm2}
checkm2_path <- file.path(results_dir, "Bins", "checkm2", "quality_report.tsv")

if (file_exists_msg(checkm2_path)) {
  checkm2 <- read_tsv(checkm2_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Quality categories
  checkm2 <- checkm2 |>
    mutate(Quality = case_when(
      Completeness >= 90 & Contamination < 5  ~ "High Quality",
      Completeness >= 50 & Contamination < 10 ~ "Medium Quality",
      TRUE                                     ~ "Low Quality"
    ))

  quality_counts <- checkm2 |>
    count(Quality) |>
    arrange(desc(n))

  cat("## Quality summary\n\n")
  knitr::kable(quality_counts, col.names = c("Quality category", "Number of MAGs"))
}
```

```{r checkm2-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (exists("checkm2")) {
  ggplot(checkm2, aes(x = Completeness, y = Contamination, colour = Quality)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "High Quality"   = "#2166ac",
      "Medium Quality" = "#f4a582",
      "Low Quality"    = "#d6604d"
    )) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(50, 90), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(5, 10), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(
      title  = "MAG quality (CheckM2)",
      x      = "Completeness (%)",
      y      = "Contamination (%)",
      colour = "Quality"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

```{r checkm2-table}
if (exists("checkm2")) {
  checkm2 |>
    arrange(desc(Completeness)) |>
    select(Name, Completeness, Contamination, Quality) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "CheckM2 results for all final MAGs")
}
```

# 5. MAG Taxonomy (GTDBTk)

```{r gtdbtk}
gtdbtk_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Bins", "GDTBTk")

read_gtdb_summary <- function(dir, pattern) {
  candidates <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(candidates) == 0) return(NULL)
  read_tsv(candidates[1], show_col_types = FALSE)
}

gtdb_bac <- NULL
gtdb_arc <- NULL

if (dir.exists(gtdbtk_dir)) {
  gtdb_bac <- read_gtdb_summary(gtdbtk_dir, "gtdbtk\\.bac120\\.summary\\.tsv")
  gtdb_arc <- read_gtdb_summary(gtdbtk_dir, "gtdbtk\\.ar53\\.summary\\.tsv")
} else {
  cat(paste0("> **Directory not found:** `", gtdbtk_dir,
             "` — GTDBTk step may not have been run.\n\n"))
}

# Combine bacteria and archaea
if (!is.null(gtdb_bac) || !is.null(gtdb_arc)) {
  gtdb_all <- bind_rows(
    if (!is.null(gtdb_bac)) gtdb_bac |> mutate(Domain = "Bacteria") else NULL,
    if (!is.null(gtdb_arc)) gtdb_arc |> mutate(Domain = "Archaea")  else NULL
  )

  # Parse phylum from classification string (d__;p__;c__;...)
  gtdb_all <- gtdb_all |>
    mutate(
      Phylum = str_extract(classification, "(?<=p__)[^;]+"),
      Phylum = if_else(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "", "Unclassified", Phylum)
    )

  phylum_counts <- gtdb_all |>
    count(Domain, Phylum, sort = TRUE)

  cat(paste0("**Total classified MAGs:** ", nrow(gtdb_all), "\n\n"))
  if (!is.null(gtdb_bac)) cat(paste0("- Bacteria: ", nrow(gtdb_bac), "\n"))
  if (!is.null(gtdb_arc)) cat(paste0("- Archaea: ",  nrow(gtdb_arc), "\n"))
}
```

```{r gtdbtk-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (exists("phylum_counts")) {
  top_phyla <- phylum_counts |>
    group_by(Phylum) |>
    summarise(total = sum(n)) |>
    slice_max(total, n = 20) |>
    pull(Phylum)

  phylum_counts |>
    filter(Phylum %in% top_phyla) |>
    mutate(Phylum = fct_reorder(Phylum, n, sum)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Phylum, fill = Domain)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Bacteria" = "#4393c3", "Archaea" = "#d6604d")) +
    labs(
      title = "Taxonomic distribution of final MAGs (top 20 phyla)",
      x     = "Number of MAGs",
      y     = "Phylum",
      fill  = "Domain"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

```{r gtdbtk-table}
if (exists("gtdb_all")) {
  gtdb_all |>
    select(user_genome, classification, Domain) |>
    arrange(Domain, classification) |>
    knitr::kable(caption = "GTDBTk classification of all final MAGs")
}
```

# 6. MAG Coverage

```{r coverage}
cov_path <- file.path(results_dir, "cat_mags_cov.txt")

if (file_exists_msg(cov_path)) {
  cov <- read_tsv(cov_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # First column is contig/MAG name; remaining columns are per-sample coverage
  cov_long <- cov |>
    rename(MAG = 1) |>
    pivot_longer(-MAG, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Coverage")

  cat(paste0("**MAGs:** ", n_distinct(cov_long$MAG),
             "  |  **Samples:** ", n_distinct(cov_long$Sample), "\n\n"))
}
```

```{r coverage-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (exists("cov_long")) {
  cov_summary <- cov_long |>
    group_by(Sample) |>
    summarise(
      Mean   = mean(Coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(Coverage, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(c(Mean, Median), names_to = "Statistic", values_to = "Coverage")

  ggplot(cov_summary, aes(x = Sample, y = Coverage, fill = Statistic)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mean" = "#4393c3", "Median" = "#d6604d")) +
    labs(
      title = "Per-sample coverage of final MAGs (trimmed mean)",
      x     = "Sample",
      y     = "Coverage",
      fill  = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

# 7. Eukaryotic MAGs (BUSCO)

```{r eukaryotes}
euk_dir  <- file.path(results_dir, "Bins", "Eukaryotic_mags_dereplicated")
busco_qc <- file.path(results_dir, "qc", "busco", "multiqc_report.html")

if (dir.exists(euk_dir)) {
  euk_files <- list.files(euk_dir, pattern = "\\.fa$", full.names = FALSE)
  n_euk <- length(euk_files)
  cat(paste0("**Number of putative eukaryotic MAGs:** ", n_euk, "\n\n"))
  if (n_euk > 0) {
    cat("MAG names:\n\n")
    cat(paste0("- ", euk_files, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat(paste0("> **Directory not found:** `", euk_dir,
             "` — eukaryotic filtering step may not have been run.\n\n"))
}

if (file.exists(busco_qc)) {
  cat(paste0("\nBUSCO MultiQC report available at: `", busco_qc, "`\n"))
} else {
  cat(paste0("> **BUSCO MultiQC report not found** (`", busco_qc,
             "`) — BUSCO step may not have been run.\n"))
}
```

# 8. SynTracker (Synteny-based strain tracking)

```{r syntracker}
syn_path <- file.path(results_dir, "SynTracker", "avg_synteny_scores_all_regions.csv")

if (file_exists_msg(syn_path)) {
  syn <- read_csv(syn_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat(paste0("**MAGs with synteny data:** ", n_distinct(syn[[1]]), "\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("**Total pairwise comparisons:** ", nrow(syn), "\n\n"))
  print(head(syn))
}
```

```{r syntracker-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (exists("syn") && ncol(syn) >= 3) {
  # Assume columns: ref_mag, query_genome, avg_synteny_score (or similar)
  score_col <- names(syn)[str_detect(names(syn), regex("score|synteny", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
  if (!is.na(score_col)) {
    ggplot(syn, aes(x = .data[[score_col]])) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#4393c3", colour = "white") +
      labs(
        title = "Distribution of average synteny scores (all regions)",
        x     = score_col,
        y     = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  }
}
```

# 9. SingleM (Metagenome completeness)

## 9.1 Microbial fraction

```{r singlem-mf}
mf_path <- file.path(results_dir, "SingleM", "SingleM_MF.tsv")

if (file_exists_msg(mf_path)) {
  mf <- read_tsv(mf_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  knitr::kable(mf, caption = "SingleM microbial fraction per sample")
}
```

```{r singlem-mf-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (exists("mf")) {
  frac_col <- names(mf)[str_detect(names(mf),
    regex("fraction|microbial|bacterial", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
  sample_col <- names(mf)[1]

  if (!is.na(frac_col)) {
    ggplot(mf, aes(x = .data[[sample_col]], y = .data[[frac_col]])) +
      geom_col(fill = "#4393c3") +
      labs(
        title = "Microbial fraction per sample (SingleM)",
        x     = "Sample",
        y     = frac_col
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
}
```

# 10. MGThermometer (Optimal Growth Temperature)

```{r mgthermometer}
ogt_path <- file.path(results_dir, "MGthermometer", "table_OGT.txt")

if (file_exists_msg(ogt_path)) {
  ogt <- read_tsv(ogt_path, show_col_types = FALSE,
                  col_names = c("MAG", "OGT"))
```

# 11. Functional Annotation (EggNOG-mapper)

```{r eggnog}
egg_path <- file.path(results_dir, "EggNOG", "allMAGs_egg.txt.emapper.annotations")

if (file_exists_msg(egg_path)) {
  egg <- read_tsv(egg_path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE,
                  col_names = c(
                    "query", "seed_ortholog", "evalue", "score",
                    "eggNOG_OGs", "max_annot_lvl", "COG_category",
                    "Description", "Preferred_name", "GOs",
                    "EC", "KEGG_ko", "KEGG_Pathway", "KEGG_Module",
                    "KEGG_Reaction", "KEGG_rclass", "BRITE",
                    "KEGG_TC", "CAZy", "BiGG_Reaction", "PFAMs"
                  ))

  cat(paste0("**Total annotated proteins:** ", nrow(egg), "\n\n"))

  # COG category distribution
  cog <- egg |>
    filter(!is.na(COG_category) & COG_category != "-") |>
    separate_rows(COG_category, sep = "") |>
    filter(COG_category != "") |>
    count(COG_category, sort = TRUE)

  ggplot(cog, aes(x = fct_reorder(COG_category, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4393c3") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "COG category distribution (EggNOG-mapper)",
      x     = "COG category",
      y     = "Number of proteins"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

# 12. Tools & References

The table below lists all tools used in this pipeline, their roles, and links to the relevant publications or repositories.

```{r tools-table, echo=FALSE}
tools_tbl <- tribble(
  ~Tool,              ~Version,    ~Role,                                              ~Reference,
  "Snakemake",        "≥8.30",     "Workflow manager",                                 "https://doi.org/10.12688/f1000research.29032.1",
  "Trim Galore",      "0.6.10",    "Adapter and quality trimming of raw reads",         "https://github.com/FelixKrueger/TrimGalore",
  "strobealign",      "0.14",      "Fast short-read aligner (mapping & index)",        "https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-022-02831-7",
```
